name: autoscript-license
description: Cloudflare Worker + Pages portal for Autoscript VPS IP licensing

scripts.dev:pages: npm run build:pages && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build:pages && wrangler pages deploy
scripts.d1:migrate:local: wrangler --config wrangler.worker.toml d1 migrations apply LICENSE_DB --local
scripts.d1:migrate:remote: wrangler --config wrangler.worker.toml d1 migrations apply LICENSE_DB --remote
